walkthroughs.body_html:
Fundamentals Of Computer Organisation & Architecture — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fundamentals Of Computer Organisation & Architecture brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fundamentals Of Computer Organisation & Architecture.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which is a high-level programming language?
options: Assembly
Machine code
Python
Binary
Internet Data Engine
Integrated Development Environment
Internal Debugging Editor
Interpreted Dynamic Executable

mcqs.q: What does an INNER JOIN return?
options: Copy code from any unrelated class.
Only rows with matching values in both tables.
Only the inner columns of each table.
All rows from both tables combined.

mcqs.q: What does inheritance allow a subclass to do?
options: Copy code from any unrelated class.
Only the inner columns of each table.
Reuse and extend the attributes and methods of its superclass.
Replace the superclass entirely.

mcqs.q: Why are passwords stored as hashes rather than plaintext?
options: Only the inner columns of each table.
Hashes are one-way - even an attacker who steals them cannot easily recover passwords.
Hashes are encryption that can be decrypted with the right key.
Hashes compress the data to save space.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Low-level language”?
options: Integrated Development Environment: editor, compiler/interpreter, debugger and tools combined in one application.
Non-executing text in source code that explains the program to human readers.
Assembly or machine code, closer to hardware, providing direct control of the processor.
Set of rules defining valid combinations of symbols and keywords in a programming language.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “High-level language”?
options: Set of rules defining valid combinations of symbols and keywords in a programming language.
Programming language close to human language (Python, Java) that must be translated to machine code.
Assembly or machine code, closer to hardware, providing direct control of the processor.
Non-executing text in source code that explains the program to human readers.
